notes.title: V1.2.0 - Sewers & Animatronic update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9eAZ_vlc4L8;full][/previewyoutube]

V1.2.0 - Sewers & Animatronic update

NEW LEVEL
- Added a new level : the Sewer

NEW ENTITY
- Added a new entity : The Animatronic (Stop moving when you look at it, but attacks after a few seconds)

FIXES
- Fixed some object placements
- Fixed some hitboxes

notes.title: V1.1.0 - Halloween update
notes.notes:
NEW ENTITY
- Added Pumpkin Head (causes reverse controls and players lose some life until they are undetected)

IMPROVEMENTS / CHANGES
- The host can choose a particular entity on each level (helps for achievements / phobias)
- Added a new setting which can disable the forced rotate view on some jumpscares
- Added a new notification system
- Added a written chat system
- Knocked out players outline is now visible behind walls
- Balls transform in pumpkins when the entity is Pumpkin Head
- Player light doesn't move anymore when walking
- Tweaked some UI

FIXES
- Fixed some inputs staying down when unfocus
- Fixed the keycard locks to be unlocked by share keys
- Fixed certain characters not entirely outlined when knocked out
- Fixed running state getting stuck when hidden
- Fixed the achievement "Who you gonna call" for clients (and not only for the host)
- Fixed the Geisha ending video (with more realistic mouth)
- Fixed a Clown page in bestiary panel
- Fixed a few hitboxes issues

notes.title: V1.0.1 - Improvements (post-release)
notes.notes:
UI
- When keys or notebook are used but can still open doors text turns light red instead of red
- By default the level chosen is the last played (or the last unlocked)
- Fixed some settings to be correctly selected with a controller
- Displayed input info on settings tab and dropdown region when using a controller
- Added an error text when connection is too long (probably because Steam data is temporarily unavailable)
- Hovering now works automatically for equipment and skill when using a controller
- Some texts are bigger in main menu
- Now players can select on keypad/padlock with A/Cross
- Added Japan server to the region dropdown
- Exp gain is now displayed separately from initial exp in the end game screen
- Fixed a rare issue with texts being invisible on Slum map
- Fixed gamma setting to be correctly applied in the main menu
- Forced close objective/map panel when teleported
- Fixed spelling mistakes
- Tweaked UI

ENTITIES
- Entities now wait and make sound when they appear to avoid attacking immediately
- Cruel doll is now slightly slower
- Entities will go faster by distance when all relics are placed
- Fixed detection animation

FIXES
- Fixed knocked out player not going back to main menu after a player leaved by the quit zone 
- Fixed gaining exp for relics objectives when leaving by the quit zone
- Fixed a rare issue where all the relics are placed but don't trigger the objective
- Fixed achievement "Roll out the red carpet" to be done only if entity is visible
- Fixed achievement "Please stop playing" when a player has already more than 10k dollars
- Added a red circle to know where the ritual is on the map when discovered
- Door screamer now starts immediately after trigger

notes.title: V1.0.0 - Full release (Slum & Geisha)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce the full release of Forsake!
Many thanks to all the players who took part in this great year of Early Access and who helped us improve the game!

LEVEL
- New level: Slum

ENTITY
- New Entity: Geisha (cause bleeding to players)

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Fixed some achievements issues (Over-equipped, Please stop playing and Green light)
- Added two new achievements:
- Slum nightmare: Complete Slum map in nightmare difficulty
- Vade retro satanas: Exorcise all the entities

IMPROVEMENTS / FIXES
- Added a pages system to the rooms panel with a manual refresh button, to improve performances when a lot of lobbies are displayed
- Fixed the outline on knocked out players
- In nightmare difficulty, disabled all hitboxes of knocked out players (to be able to take the dropped keys below them)
- Fixed some fences and bushes hitboxes for Suburbs and Wood Camp
- Other minor fixes

Thanks to our official beta testers who allowed us to fix the last bugs: 
AviDoro / Betherz / BlueJediSith / crazziemom / dragonfire / Elfi / Hattie / Hottdollsteak / iGamerKatie / Jayy_Schubiee / Kenz / KitsuneSamurai94 / Ladyvamp21 / LadyYuuki / LoguetownLackey / NobleVampire / QueenSalem / Ragnokos / scottimus75 / ScorpionV / ssrjazz / WhosSteal / WolfOnF1r3

And a special thanks to all of you who gave us feedback on our discord: https://discord.gg/vgrdZfp

Have a horrific time!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7EqDhfgJsmc;full][/previewyoutube]

It is with great honor that we are releasing Forsake on Steam today!

This release of the game in early access is an opportunity for us to offer you a first experience of the game and to allow you to participate actively in the further development!

For that, you can join us on our discord to share your experience, give us feedback, or report a bug.
https://discord.gg/vgrdZfp


We are a small team, but our ambitions are big.
Many updates are already planned to offer you an even more terrifying experience!

Among the upcoming additions :
- New locations to explore
- New paranormal entities
- New equipment
- New weapons
- Customized events based on player behavior
- A skill tree
- A VR version
- Several difficulties
etc...


To support the development of Forsake, and to help us reach a maximum of players, don't hesitate to talk about it around you!

A huge thank you to you,
Horrifically,

Hugo, Thomas and Florian from Unseen Interactive
